# SweetAlert2

Unmodified distribution files from **11.26.25**, MIT, downloaded from the
[npm release](https://registry.npmjs.org/sweetalert2/-/sweetalert2-11.26.25.tgz)
on 2026-10-11. [Source and documentation](https://github.com/sweetalert2/sweetalert2)
and [official guide](https://sweetalert2.github.io/). The licence is served alongside
the assets as `LICENSE`; no CDN or runtime package installation is required.
